about: KOOMPI AI tasks with deterministic checks. tune is what the improver sees; held is only for adoption. {AINAME}, {KERNEL}, {HOSTNAME} and {YEAR} are filled in by run.py. Every tool that would leave the machine or run something is stubbed.
